nodes.puszcz.text.t: The deserter bows three times and vanishes into the forest as if he'd never been there. All he leaves behind is a smell of smoke.

nodes.s.options.[zwiaz].text.t: Tie him up and take him to the patrol.

nodes.s.text.t: A man in a rumpled uniform cowers under a bush. "Don't kill me. I don't want to fight. I only want to go home to my wife." He unbuckles the knife from his belt and throws it in the grass.

nodes.zostaw.text.t: The deserter clenches his teeth, but doesn't beg again. You walk on and feel his eyes on your back all the way to the bend.

nodes.zwiaz.text.t: The patrol in a nearby village pays fifteen groats and looks at the deserter like a broken hinge. The man doesn't fight back. That's the worst of it.
